title: The Angels And Pure Spirits The Concordance Of Their Reports

questions.question: What did the traveler want to make stronger?
questions.answer: His faith and his knowing of Allah.

questions.question: What did he think is the highest and best thing a person can have?
questions.answer: Loving Allah.

questions.question: What does that love grow from?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: Where did the traveler look when he wanted to learn more?
questions.answer: He looked up at the sky.

questions.question: In his thinking, what is the most valuable thing in the universe?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Which living beings did he see as more special than other living things?
questions.answer: Those with awareness.

questions.question: Why did he think the heavens must have living beings in them?
questions.answer: Because life is so precious, so the beautiful heavens should not be empty of living, spiritual beings.

questions.question: What kind of beings in the heavens was he hoping to meet?
questions.answer: The angels and other heavenly dwellers.

questions.question: What made him think this was possible?
questions.answer: Reports that angels had appeared and had been seen by people.

questions.question: Which angel is named in the passage?
questions.answer: Jibreel, or Gabriel, peace be upon him.

questions.question: Which Prophet is named as seeing Gabriel?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What did the heavenly voice say the angels believed first?
questions.answer: The truths of faith brought to the prophets, especially to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What special gift brought by Prophet Muhammad is named?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What did the pure spirits say together about the Creator?
questions.answer: That Allah surely exists, is One, and has holy attributes.

questions.question: How does the passage describe their many matching messages?
questions.answer: As a very clear guide, bright like the sun.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler’s faith after hearing them?
questions.answer: It became brighter and rose higher.

questions.question: Why are the angels’ words important to the traveler?
questions.answer: Because they speak about the Creator and they agree with one another.

questions.question: What main lesson did the traveler learn from the angels?
questions.answer: Their united witness points to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What did the traveler know is the source of all true human goodness and excellence?
questions.answer: Love for Allah.

questions.question: What two things lead to that love?
questions.answer: Faith in Allah and knowledge of Allah.

questions.question: How strongly did the traveler want to move forward?
questions.answer: With all his outer and inner strength.

questions.question: After raising his head, what part of creation did he study?
questions.answer: The heavens.

questions.question: What did he say all other things are made to serve?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Among living things, which group did he place highest?
questions.answer: Conscious beings.

questions.question: Why did he mention the earth filling and emptying again and again?
questions.answer: To show that life is precious and increased again and again.

questions.question: What did he conclude about the heavens from this idea?
questions.answer: That they should have living, spiritual, aware inhabitants.

questions.question: What example showed him that heavenly beings can appear to people?
questions.answer: Gabriel appearing before Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and the Companions seeing this.

questions.question: Why did the traveler want to speak with the people of the heavens?
questions.answer: To learn what they say about the Creator.

questions.question: Who answered him?
questions.answer: A voice from the heavens.

questions.question: According to that voice, whom did the angels believe in and support?
questions.answer: The prophets and especially Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, with the message brought through them.

questions.question: What did the voice say all the pure spirits agreed on?
questions.answer: Allah’s necessary existence, His oneness, and His sacred qualities.

questions.question: Did the passage show them disagreeing or agreeing with one another?
questions.answer: Agreeing with one another.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how clear their agreement is?
questions.answer: The brightness of the sun.

questions.question: What change came to the traveler after this lesson?
questions.answer: His light of faith grew brighter and lifted upward.

questions.question: What big truth do the angels’ matching reports help show?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and is One.

questions.question: Why is their agreement a strong proof in the passage?
questions.answer: Because many pure beings all say the same true message together.

questions.question: What was the traveler already aware of before looking at the heavens?
questions.answer: That the greatest perfection is loving Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say that love comes from?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and knowing Him.

questions.question: What was the traveler trying to increase?
questions.answer: The strength of his faith and his understanding.

questions.question: What did he do before speaking to himself?
questions.answer: He lifted his head toward the sky.

questions.question: In his thoughts, what is worth more than anything else in the universe?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: What kind of living thing did he value most?
questions.answer: A conscious living being.

questions.question: What does he notice the world keeps doing over time?
questions.answer: It keeps being emptied and filled again.

questions.question: What reason did he give for thinking the skies have inhabitants?
questions.answer: Since life is so precious, the great and beautiful heavens should also have living, spiritual, aware beings.

questions.question: What past events supported this idea?
questions.answer: Angels had been seen and had spoken with people.

questions.question: Who is given as the example of an angel appearing?
questions.answer: Gabriel, peace be upon him.

questions.question: Whom did Gabriel appear to in the passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and also in front of the Companions.

questions.question: What did the traveler most want to learn from the heavenly beings?
questions.answer: What they say about the Creator.

questions.question: What did the heavenly voice say came through the angels to the prophets?
questions.answer: The teachings of faith.

questions.question: Who is named as the chief of the prophets in that message?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What three things did the pure spirits testify about Allah?
questions.answer: His existence, His oneness, and His sacred attributes.

questions.question: How were their messages related to one another?
questions.answer: They matched and agreed.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler’s faith-light after hearing this?
questions.answer: It shone more and rose from earth toward the heavens.

questions.question: What is one main idea of this passage section?
questions.answer: The agreement of the angels guides people to believe in Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What did the traveler believe is the root of all human excellence?
questions.answer: Love of Allah.

questions.question: What makes that love begin in a person?
questions.answer: Faith in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: What did he want to keep growing?
questions.answer: His faith and his knowledge.

questions.question: When he looked upward, what did he start thinking about?
questions.answer: The heavens and who lives there.

questions.question: What did he call the most precious thing?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Which is higher in his order: just being alive or being aware?
questions.answer: Being aware.

questions.question: What did he think the earth’s repeating changes show?
questions.answer: That life is very important.

questions.question: From that, what did he decide about the heavens?
questions.answer: That they have fitting inhabitants with life, spirit, and awareness.

questions.question: What story from people before helped support his idea?
questions.answer: That angels had appeared and spoken to humans.

questions.question: What was the traveler wishing he could do?
questions.answer: Talk with the inhabitants of the heavens.

questions.question: Why did he think their words mattered so much?
questions.answer: Because what they say about the Creator is very important.

questions.question: What answer came to him?
questions.answer: A voice from the heavens spoke.

questions.question: What did the voice say the angels had accepted before all others?
questions.answer: The truths of faith delivered to the prophets through them.

questions.question: Which Prophet is especially mentioned in that message?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What book is mentioned with him?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What did all the pure spirits witness together?
questions.answer: Allah’s sure existence, His oneness, and His holy attributes.

questions.question: What comparison shows how clear their agreement is?
questions.answer: It is like the brightness of the sun.

questions.question: What effect did this lesson have on the traveler?
questions.answer: His faith became stronger and more radiant.

questions.question: What did the traveler see as the greatest human perfection?
questions.answer: Loving Allah.

questions.question: What are the two roots of that love in the passage?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and knowledge of Allah.

questions.question: What was he eager to improve more and more?
questions.answer: His faith and understanding.

questions.question: Where did he turn his attention next?
questions.answer: To the sky.

questions.question: What did he say everything else is made to serve?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Of all living creatures, which ones did he prize most?
questions.answer: Conscious ones.

questions.question: What repeating event on earth did he mention?
questions.answer: The world keeps emptying and filling again.

questions.question: What conclusion did he draw from the value of life?
questions.answer: The heavens should also contain living, spiritual, conscious beings.

questions.question: What kind of reports had come down from long ago?
questions.answer: Reports of angels being seen and speaking with people.

questions.question: Which angel is named in those reports?
questions.answer: Gabriel, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What group besides the Prophet is mentioned as seeing this?
questions.answer: The Companions.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to ask the heavenly inhabitants about?
questions.answer: Their words about the Creator.

questions.question: What did the heavenly voice tell him to know first?
questions.answer: That the angels believed in the articles of faith brought to the prophets.

questions.question: Which Prophet is given first place in that statement?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Besides the angels, who else from among them gave witness?
questions.answer: The pure spirits who appeared before people.

questions.question: What truth did they all say together?
questions.answer: That Allah necessarily exists, is One, and has sacred attributes.

questions.question: Why can their witness guide the traveler well?
questions.answer: Because so many of their messages match each other clearly.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler after hearing their lesson?
questions.answer: His faith-light became brighter and rose upward.

questions.question: What does the passage say is the beginning of all human perfections?
questions.answer: Love of Allah.

questions.question: What two things bring that love?
questions.answer: Believing in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: What did the traveler wish to keep building up?
questions.answer: Stronger faith and deeper knowledge.

questions.question: What direction did he look when searching for another lesson?
questions.answer: Up to the heavens.

questions.question: What did he call the dearest thing in the universe?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Which is more honored in his thinking: all living things or living things with awareness?
questions.answer: Living things with awareness.

questions.question: What was the point of saying the earth keeps renewing its living things?
questions.answer: To show how valuable life is.

questions.question: What did that make him think about the heavens?
questions.answer: That they must have beings with life, spirit, and consciousness.

questions.question: What example did he remember about an angel being seen?
questions.answer: Gabriel appeared to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and was seen by the Companions.

questions.question: What did the traveler hope to gain by meeting heavenly beings?
questions.answer: To hear their thoughts about the Creator.

questions.question: Who spoke to him while he was thinking?
questions.answer: A heavenly voice.

questions.question: What message did the voice give about the angels’ belief?
questions.answer: They had believed in the truths of faith sent to the prophets through them.

questions.question: Which messenger is highlighted above the others there?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What did the pure spirits all testify to?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence, His oneness, and His sacred qualities.

questions.question: Did the passage present their witness as mixed up or united?
questions.answer: United.

questions.question: What image is used for the guidance of their shared witness?
questions.answer: A guide as bright as the sun.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler’s faith after this?
questions.answer: It shone more strongly and rose heavenward.

questions.question: What lesson from this section can a student say in one sentence?
questions.answer: The angels’ united testimony helps show that Allah truly exists and is One.
